items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: When I went in that band... Raymond Scott and Webster had black and white... he had Ben Webster on tenor

ctx.x: Did you want to go into that era, or do you want to talk about something else?

No, it was the turning point. In the first place, when I left Woody, I was looking for a job, and I was walking down the street and I saw Cozy Cole, and he said Raymond Scott needs a drummer. And this was only a couple of days after I was without a job. So I went up and tried out for the job -- he tried everybody in New York City.
What job were you trying out for?
